title: Draft RFP ? MATOC IDIQ 8(a) Construction ? Fort Drum, NY
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.419TH CSB.W6QM MICC-FT DRUM
detail_text: Amendment 0003: Update response time; The MICC - Fort Drum, is releasing this Draft Request for Proposal (RFP) for a planned Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) under an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract, set aside for eligible 8(a) construction firms. This notice is issued for market research and planning purposes only. It does not constitute a formal solicitation, and no award will result from this posting. The Government seeks industry feedback on the draft solicitation documents to improve clarity, feasibility, and competitiveness prior to final release. Interested parties are encouraged to review the attached draft documents and submit comments or questions by September 26, 2025. Submitting Questions: Log into PIEE with your Proposal Manager role Navigate to the Solicitation Module and locate this posting Use the ?Submit Questions? or ?Communicate with Solicitation Manager? feature to send inquiries securely.
